# Upstream: docker/awesome-compose

- Repository: https://github.com/docker/awesome-compose
- Commit: 30f4b7f6a6c3b0c0ecf4d4efb0de203c48d11562
- Licence: CC0-1.0
- Fetch date: 2026-09-26

Ten real Dockerfiles from different sample projects in this repository, flattened into this
folder with a name of the form `<sample>-<subfolder>.Dockerfile` (or `<sample>.Dockerfile` when
the sample has no subfolder), plus the upstream `LICENSE`. Each file's original path at the
pinned commit:

- `react-express-mongodb-backend.Dockerfile`: `react-express-mongodb/backend/Dockerfile`
- `react-express-mongodb-frontend.Dockerfile`: `react-express-mongodb/frontend/Dockerfile`
- `django-app.Dockerfile`: `django/app/Dockerfile`
- `flask-app.Dockerfile`: `flask/app/Dockerfile`
- `nginx-flask-mongo-flask.Dockerfile`: `nginx-flask-mongo/flask/Dockerfile`
- `react-nginx.Dockerfile`: `react-nginx/Dockerfile`
- `spring-postgres-backend.Dockerfile`: `spring-postgres/backend/Dockerfile`
- `react-java-mysql-backend.Dockerfile`: `react-java-mysql/backend/Dockerfile`
- `nginx-golang-backend.Dockerfile`: `nginx-golang/backend/Dockerfile`
- `vuejs.Dockerfile`: `vuejs/vuejs/Dockerfile`
